title: Board Typst Emoji Font Load
description: Fix board WASM Typst emoji icon rendering: load rs/assets/NotoColorEmoji-subset.ttf into board_icon_codec font list and set Typst text font for emoji: branch so glyphs are not tofu.
summary: Board `emoji:` icons compile with Typst but only `typst_assets` fonts were registered, so emoji codepoints fell back to U+FFFD (tofu). Loaded bundled `rs/assets/NotoColorEmoji-subset.ttf` into the shared Typst font list and set `#set text(font: "Noto Color Emoji")` for the emoji branch. Added Rust regression test `board_icon_codec_resolves_emoji_prefix_without_tofu`.
